title: Ambiguous vendor write reconciliation
intent: Every external write reaches one scientifically coherent outcome across timeout and retry conditions.
material_effect: Laboratory teams receive one authoritative record while reconciliation preserves throughput and auditability.

rules.desired_state: Every vendor write carries a stable external request identity and an immutable canonical payload digest.
rules.verification: The conformance run reads the vendor state by stable identity and reconciles its payload digest before each retry.

rules.desired_state: A timeout activates readback and reconciliation before the worker chooses commit completion or a bounded retry.
rules.verification: Injected pre-commit and post-commit timeouts produce one vendor effect and one closed reconciliation record.
